Messages.Author: Bobby_Doc
Messages.Body:
From Rules:
6.5.3. Rescue a Vampire from Torpor
This action costs 2 blood, which can be paid by the acting vampire or
the rescued vampire, or the cost may be split between them. Allies
cannot take this action.

So that mean I can rescue another Metuselahs vampire from torpor and
let that vampire pay all the cost (if it have blood). Regardless of
it's Metuselahs wishes. Right?

Robert
